purpose: Single catalogue of responsibilities, availability boundaries and handoffs for the unified website workflow.
operating_rule: A tool is active only after the current client confirms it can invoke the tool. Repository configuration or documentation alone is not proof of a live connection.

tools.name: UI/UX Pro Max
tools.responsibility: Propose product-aware information architecture, design patterns, colors, typography, UX and accessibility.

tools.name: Taste
tools.responsibility: Establish distinctive art direction, challenge generic layouts, inspect browser output and prioritize visual corrections.

tools.name: Penpot / Figma / Lunacy
tools.responsibility: Supply the selected authoritative frames, variables, components, assets and interaction specifications. Select one authority per feature.

tools.name: shadcn/ui MCP
tools.responsibility: Default accessible primitive foundation and registry path. Adapt source-owned components to project tokens.

tools.name: 21st.dev MCP and skill
tools.responsibility: Search and compare candidate components; retrieve source only after shortlisting and within the free allowance.

tools.name: Watermelon UI MCP
tools.responsibility: Search public components, blocks, dashboards and templates; inspect source and dependencies; compose page sections.

tools.name: React Bits through Manus
tools.responsibility: Discover expressive React animations, backgrounds and micro-interactions through Manus; copy selected source only after review.

tools.name: Motion Primitives
tools.responsibility: Provide copy-in animated React components built around Motion and Tailwind when the chosen stack matches.

tools.name: Motion for React (formerly Framer Motion)
tools.repo_state: agent skill installer configured; runtime not installed
tools.responsibility: Own React component state transitions, gestures, layout animation and enter/exit transitions.

tools.name: GSAP and GSAP skills
tools.repo_state: agent skill installer configured; runtime not installed
tools.responsibility: Own complex timelines, coordinated cross-element choreography, scroll narratives and SVG morphing.

tools.name: Haikei
tools.responsibility: Generate original SVG/PNG backgrounds. Export, optimize and commit approved assets; never make the editor a runtime dependency.

tools.name: Alibaba Page Agent
tools.responsibility: Explore a running local/staging page through DOM-aware natural-language browser interaction. Do not treat it as a repeatable test runner.

tools.name: Playwright browser tests
tools.repo_state: CI setup detection configured; app tests await scaffold
tools.responsibility: Run deterministic user journeys, assertions, responsive checks and regression tests.

tools.name: Strix with local Ollama
tools.responsibility: Perform authorized security testing against the repository or explicitly scoped local/staging target; review and retest findings.

tools.name: GitHub Actions, CodeQL, Gitleaks, Pa11y and Lighthouse
tools.repo_state: configured; app-specific gates conditional on scaffold
tools.responsibility: Run repository validation, static analysis, secret scanning, accessibility, performance and release gates.

tools.name: Emil Kowalski design-engineering skills
tools.responsibility: Build, review and audit motion with explicit purpose, easing, duration, interruptibility, GPU properties, reduced-motion and hover-gating criteria.
tools.selection_rule: Use alongside GSAP/Motion when high-craft motion is required. Install only relevant skills such as animate, review-animations or improve-animations; avoid loading the whole pack by default.
tools.cost_boundary: Public skill files are free; requires a compatible coding-agent runtime.

tools.name: UX Skills
tools.responsibility: Challenge product assumptions, maintain evidence and user intent, interrogate existing design systems and produce engineering-ready UX decisions.
tools.selection_rule: Use when product discovery, user journeys or UX rationale are important. Does not replace UI/UX Pro Max or the design-source authority.
tools.cost_boundary: Open skill repository; compatible agent and setup environment required.

tools.name: Frontend AI Skills catalogue
tools.responsibility: Discover narrowly scoped frontend skills for React, animation, 3D, accessibility, performance and testing.
tools.selection_rule: Search the catalogue for a missing specialist capability. Do not install its entire 70+ skill collection; overlapping skill packs increase conflicts and context load.
tools.cost_boundary: Public skill catalogue; no paid model API required, but some individual skills may reference external tools.

tools.name: Microsoft Playwright MCP
tools.responsibility: Allow an MCP agent to inspect and interact with browser pages through structured accessibility snapshots, navigation, forms, network mocking, tracing and screenshots.
tools.selection_rule: Use for agent-driven browser exploration. Keep Playwright's test runner for deterministic assertions; isolate browser profiles and avoid authenticated/personal browser data.
tools.cost_boundary: Open-source Apache-2.0 server; needs Node.js, browser runtime and a compatible MCP client.

tools.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
tools.responsibility: Inspect Chrome console, network, DOM and performance traces; run browser automation and diagnose performance regressions.
tools.selection_rule: Use when Chrome-specific diagnostics or performance traces are needed. Do not add if Playwright traces and Lighthouse already answer the question.
tools.cost_boundary: Open-source project; needs Chrome and a compatible computer/client. Its browser context is sensitive and must be isolated.

tools.name: Storybook and Storybook MCP addon
tools.responsibility: Create isolated component stories, document variants and states, inspect the component system through the Storybook MCP addon, and support component-level review.
tools.selection_rule: Adopt once several reusable components exist or visual variants need a shared catalogue. Storybook MCP moved into the Storybook monorepo in v10.6; follow current official docs, not the old standalone repository.
tools.cost_boundary: Open-source Storybook core/addon; requires an app scaffold and compatible agent client.

tools.name: Base UI
tools.responsibility: Provide unstyled, accessible behavior primitives for overlays, menus, inputs, navigation and other complex controls.
tools.selection_rule: Compare with the primitive base selected by shadcn. Use Base UI or Radix as the foundation for a given component family, not competing foundations for the same control.
tools.cost_boundary: MIT-licensed open-source library; runtime dependency only after framework selection.

tools.name: Adobe React Aria Components
tools.responsibility: Provide interaction and accessibility behavior for complex widgets, internationalization, focus management and keyboard navigation.
tools.selection_rule: Prefer for demanding accessibility, internationalization or complex interaction requirements. Do not layer it on top of an equivalent shadcn/Radix/Base UI primitive.
tools.cost_boundary: Open-source repository; verify the package-specific license and dependencies before use.

tools.name: Radix UI Primitives
tools.responsibility: Provide unstyled accessible React primitives with keyboard navigation, focus management, collision handling and composable state.
tools.selection_rule: Use only where the selected shadcn base or an existing project component is not the better fit. Do not mix Radix and Base UI primitives inside one component implementation.
tools.cost_boundary: Open-source primitives; verify individual package terms and current API.

tools.name: Mantine
tools.responsibility: Offer a cohesive full React component system, hooks, form handling, notifications, charts and higher-level components.
tools.selection_rule: Consider only if the project deliberately chooses a complete library instead of copy-in shadcn primitives. Do not combine Mantine's global styling/theme with shadcn as parallel systems.
tools.cost_boundary: MIT-licensed open-source core; inspect any separately sold premium templates or services before use.

tools.name: TanStack Query
tools.responsibility: Fetch, cache, synchronize, retry, paginate and mutate remote server data with explicit loading/error/stale states.
tools.selection_rule: Add when the feature has real remote/server state. Keep simple static/local state in React until a query/cache layer is needed.
tools.cost_boundary: Open-source MIT library; does not provide a backend or free database.

tools.name: TanStack Table
tools.responsibility: Power sortable, filterable, groupable, pageable and virtualizable data grids while leaving markup and styling under project control.
tools.selection_rule: Use for real data tables with multiple interactions; use a semantic HTML table for simple static/tabular content.
tools.cost_boundary: Open-source MIT library; no hosted service required.

tools.name: React Hook Form
tools.responsibility: Manage performant form state, field registration, validation lifecycle, submission and complex dynamic forms.
tools.selection_rule: Use for multi-field, dynamic or validated forms. Native HTML forms and controlled React state are enough for small forms.
tools.cost_boundary: MIT-licensed open-source library; no hosted API required.

tools.name: Zod
tools.responsibility: Define runtime schemas and infer static types for form inputs, API payloads, configuration and persisted data.
tools.selection_rule: Use one schema at boundaries that need runtime validation; avoid duplicating incompatible frontend and backend shapes.
tools.cost_boundary: MIT-licensed open-source library.

tools.name: Mock Service Worker
tools.responsibility: Mock REST/GraphQL/network responses at the request boundary so UI states can be tested without a paid or live backend.
tools.selection_rule: Use for realistic request-level tests and loading/error/empty cases. Do not mistake mock data for a production backend.
tools.cost_boundary: Open-source project; no paid API required.

tools.name: Vitest
tools.responsibility: Run unit, integration and component tests with coverage, mocks, browser mode and Vite-consistent module handling.
tools.selection_rule: Prefer for a Vite-based project. Select the test runner once; do not add Vitest and Jest for the same test layer without a concrete compatibility need.
tools.cost_boundary: MIT-licensed open-source test runner; requires Node.js and application scaffold.

tools.name: React Testing Library
tools.responsibility: Test React components through accessible roles, labels, text and user-visible behavior instead of implementation details.
tools.selection_rule: Use with the selected unit test runner for user-observable component behavior. Prefer accessible queries and real interaction simulation.
tools.cost_boundary: MIT-licensed open-source test library.

tools.name: axe-core
tools.responsibility: Check rendered HTML interfaces for common WCAG and ARIA accessibility defects inside component and browser tests.
tools.selection_rule: Integrate into Playwright/component tests where feasible. Automated checks catch only part of accessibility problems; retain keyboard and screen-reader/manual reviews.
tools.cost_boundary: Open-source MPL-2.0 engine; no hosted audit service required.

tools.name: Recharts
tools.responsibility: Build composable React charts with axes, tooltips, legends and responsive behavior for real datasets.
tools.selection_rule: Use for conventional React dashboards and charts. Choose one charting system for a feature; do not introduce charts merely for decoration.
tools.cost_boundary: MIT-licensed open-source project; charts still need accessible text/table alternatives.

tools.name: Lucide Icons
tools.responsibility: Provide consistent lightweight outline icons with web framework packages and SVG sources.
tools.selection_rule: Recommended default icon family for a new UI. Avoid mixing icon families without an explicit brand or semantic reason.
tools.cost_boundary: ISC-licensed and free for commercial/personal use; does not include brand logos.

tools.name: Tabler Icons
tools.responsibility: Provide a large set of consistent outline and filled icons across React, SVG, webfont and other framework packages.
tools.selection_rule: Alternative to Lucide when icon coverage/style better matches. Select Lucide or Tabler as the primary family; do not load both by default.
tools.cost_boundary: MIT-licensed icon set; preserve notices where required.

tools.name: Three.js
tools.responsibility: Render custom 3D scenes, geometry, materials, lights, cameras, shader effects and spatial interactions in WebGL/WebGPU-capable browsers.
tools.selection_rule: Use only when a 3D experience materially serves the product. Set mobile fallbacks, low-power behavior and a strict performance budget.
tools.cost_boundary: MIT-licensed open-source runtime; GPU performance and asset creation remain implementation costs.

tools.name: React Three Fiber
tools.responsibility: Compose interactive Three.js scenes declaratively with reusable React components and hooks.
tools.selection_rule: Use with Three.js when the project is React and declarative scene composition helps. Match the major version to the selected React version.
tools.cost_boundary: MIT-licensed open-source project; renderer and GPU constraints still apply.

tools.name: Drei
tools.responsibility: Provide maintained helpers, controls, loaders, abstractions and common scene building blocks for React Three Fiber.
tools.selection_rule: Add only when a helper saves meaningful code; inspect bundle and per-helper dependencies.
tools.cost_boundary: MIT-licensed open-source library.

tools.name: dotLottie Web
tools.responsibility: Play Lottie and dotLottie animations through a WebAssembly renderer with React and other framework integrations.
tools.selection_rule: Use for supplied/licensed authored vector animations and state-machine assets. Player license does not grant rights to third-party animation files.
tools.cost_boundary: MIT-licensed player; verify each animation asset's own license.

tools.name: Lenis
tools.responsibility: Coordinate smooth scroll behavior for carefully designed scroll-led or WebGL-synchronized experiences.
tools.selection_rule: Not a global default. Preserve native scrolling where possible, honor reduced motion and integrate scroll timing explicitly with GSAP/ScrollTrigger.
tools.cost_boundary: MIT-licensed open-source runtime; must be performance and accessibility tested.

tools.name: SVGO
tools.responsibility: Remove redundant SVG metadata and optimize exported vector assets while preserving intended appearance.
tools.selection_rule: Run on committed exported SVGs where optimization is beneficial; visually compare output before replacing originals.
tools.cost_boundary: MIT-licensed Node.js tool; local or CI execution.

tools.name: Sharp
tools.responsibility: Resize, crop, convert and optimize raster images for responsive web delivery and build pipelines.
tools.selection_rule: Use for build-time image processing when needed. Prefer appropriately sized source images and avoid introducing server image processing for a static site.
tools.cost_boundary: Open-source; verify current package license and native platform requirements before installation.

tools.name: Biome
tools.responsibility: Format and lint JavaScript, TypeScript, JSX, JSON, CSS and other supported files with one fast toolchain.
tools.selection_rule: Choose Biome OR ESLint plus Prettier based on ecosystem needs. Do not run multiple formatters over the same files.
tools.cost_boundary: Open-source with MIT/Apache-2.0 licensing; check individual components and versions.

tools.name: Knip
tools.responsibility: Find unused files, exports, dependencies, devDependencies and binaries to reduce project bloat and maintenance risks.
tools.selection_rule: Run after the app has meaningful source and package metadata; review findings before removing code that may be used dynamically.
tools.cost_boundary: Open-source CLI; inspect its current license and release docs before use.

tools.name: Google OSV-Scanner
tools.responsibility: Match resolved dependencies and lockfiles against the open OSV vulnerability database and optionally check dependency license policies.
tools.selection_rule: Use as a supplementary dependency scanner when a lockfile exists. Avoid duplicating the same scheduled scan in multiple CI workflows.
tools.cost_boundary: Open-source scanner and advisory data; network access to advisory sources required.

tools.name: Trivy
tools.responsibility: Scan filesystems, dependency inventories, containers, IaC, secrets and licenses; generate SBOM and vulnerability evidence.
tools.selection_rule: Use when supply-chain, container, IaC or license coverage is required. Keep scans scoped and avoid overlapping every scanner on every commit.
tools.cost_boundary: Open-source scanner; local execution or free CI is possible, while hosted platforms and some services may be paid.

tools.name: OWASP ZAP
tools.responsibility: Perform dynamic web application security testing against an explicitly authorized staging target and report common web vulnerabilities.
tools.selection_rule: Only run against owned/authorized staging with test data and a safe scan profile. Never scan third-party sites or production data by default.
tools.cost_boundary: Apache-2.0 open-source scanner; requires compatible runtime and careful target authorization.

tools.name: Vite
tools.responsibility: Provide development server, hot-module replacement, plugin integration and optimized frontend build output.
tools.selection_rule: Strong default candidate for a client-rendered React app. Do not select it before the product's rendering and routing needs are decided.
tools.cost_boundary: MIT-licensed open-source build tool.

tools.name: Astro
tools.responsibility: Build content-heavy websites with static-first output and optional interactive islands or framework integrations.
tools.selection_rule: Prefer for content-led marketing, documentation and static publishing. Choose React/Vite/Next-style application architecture instead when the product is highly interactive.
tools.cost_boundary: MIT-licensed open-source framework; deployment and server adapters may have separate infrastructure costs.

tools.name: Astro Starlight
tools.responsibility: Create accessible, high-performance documentation sites with navigation, search and content conventions.
tools.selection_rule: Use only if the project needs a public documentation portal; it is not the website's application framework.
tools.cost_boundary: MIT-licensed open-source framework; static output can be hosted on GitHub Pages.

tools.name: Supabase
tools.responsibility: Provide Postgres database, authentication, storage, realtime and server-side functions for features needing a backend.
tools.selection_rule: Do not add for static/mock-only sites. Self-hosting requires compute and operations; managed free tiers have quotas and can require billing controls. Keep MCP access read-only unless mutations are explicitly needed.
tools.cost_boundary: Open-source core; managed cloud quotas/pricing and self-hosting infrastructure are separate. Never assume unlimited free hosting.

tools.name: Appwrite
tools.responsibility: Provide authentication, database, file storage, functions, messaging, realtime and hosted/self-managed app infrastructure with agent-oriented MCP support.
tools.selection_rule: Compare with Supabase only after writing backend requirements. Do not use both for the same backend problem. Self-hosting needs Docker and compute; cloud free plan has limits.
tools.cost_boundary: BSD-3-Clause open-source platform; managed free tier is quota-limited and infrastructure is not free when self-hosted.

tools.name: Umami Analytics
tools.responsibility: Provide privacy-oriented web analytics, traffic and conversion metrics under a self-hosted deployment or its separately governed cloud service.
tools.selection_rule: Only add if product metrics are needed and the privacy/consent approach is defined. Self-hosting requires a server and PostgreSQL; repository hosting does not supply this.
tools.cost_boundary: MIT-licensed application; self-hosting requires ongoing compute/database. Cloud services may have paid limits.

tools.name: Zustand
tools.responsibility: Manage small shared client-side state stores with low ceremony and selector-based subscriptions.
tools.selection_rule: Start with local React state and context. Add Zustand only when cross-component shared state becomes awkward; do not introduce multiple global-state libraries.
tools.cost_boundary: Open-source library; verify current license and API before installation.

coverage_note: Curated public GitHub scan, not an exhaustive enumeration of all GitHub repositories. Candidates are not automatically installed or connected. Each entry distinguishes repository review from active client/runtime availability.
selection_policy: Use capability-triggered selection, not tool accumulation. Verify current releases, component/package license, third-party notices, dependencies, permissions, client compatibility and actual cost boundary before activating a candidate.
candidate_status_policy: Every reviewed-candidate record has repo_url, activation, selection_rule and cost_boundary. Candidate records are not considered installed, connected or active.
